items.title: Scarlet Metal Pumpkin Scythe
items.desc:
Beneath the twilight of All Hallows’ Eve, this scarlet metal scythe stands as a quiet reaper of autumn shadows.
Its crimson blade glimmers with faint, cold radiance, forged to harvest the fading glow of dying twilight.
Nestled upon its handle rests a grinning jack-o’-lantern, its hollow eyes burning with soft amber flame, holding the whispers of harvest and midnight enchantment.
Where autumn mists drift across the dusk, this scythe carries the soul of Halloween—equal parts eerie grace and warm, spooky wonder.
A wearable relic for those who wander the veil between harvest joy and shadowed night.
